title: Machine Learning Engineer
description: We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer with 2+ years of Python, scikit-learn, TensorFlow or PyTorch. Experience with NLP, data pipelines, MLflow/Kubeflow, and SQL. Deploy models to production, optimize inference, build feature stores.

title: Senior Data Scientist
description: 5+ years data science experience. Deep expertise in statistical modeling, A/B testing, causal inference. Python (pandas, numpy, sklearn), SQL, Spark. Communicate insights to C-suite. PhD or equivalent preferred.

title: Full Stack Developer (React + Node)
description: 1-3 years with React.js and Node.js. RESTful APIs, PostgreSQL, Docker, Git. TypeScript preferred. Next.js and AWS a plus.

title: Data Analyst
description: SQL (advanced), Python/R, Tableau or Power BI, Excel. Build dashboards and reports. Present insights to stakeholders. Finance domain experience preferred.

title: NLP Research Engineer
description: Build and fine-tune large language models. Transformers, HuggingFace, PyTorch. Research on text classification, NER, summarization. Python, CUDA experience. Publications preferred.

title: AI/ML Product Manager
description: PM with strong AI/ML understanding to lead model deployment and MLOps product. 3+ years PM experience, technical background, stakeholder management, roadmap planning.

title: Junior Python Developer
description: 0-1 year Python experience. Django or Flask basics, REST APIs, Git, SQL basics. Will mentor and train. Freshers welcome.

title: DevOps Engineer
description: 4+ years DevOps. AWS/GCP/Azure (production), Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD (Jenkins/GitHub Actions), Terraform, Linux administration, Prometheus/Grafana monitoring.
